selection: Exact VIDEO06 six takes x two views x held/control intervals,24 sequences. Same common start/end frames for both arms. All outcomes retained.
native: Every actual raw decoded frame between each frozen first/last frame; sequential decode from frame zero, no seeking, duplicate filling, timestamp interpolation or motion smoothing.
method: VIDEO06 masks/features/LK/FB/support gates unchanged. Native path starts with same feature identities and carries them through extra frames; no reseeding inside compared intervals.
windows: Every adjacent10Hz pair plus every VIDEO06~0.6s rolling window. Both methods measured over identical endpoints; qualified support and endpoint agreement reported separately. Never count native substeps as extra independent trials.

background_reference_v2.basis: Agent inspection of frozen VIDEO06 raw first/mid/last panels: primary right-hand table/window edge excludes hand/block workspace. Secondary unchanged. Separate ancillary comparison with old background mask; no change to glyph arm or qualification thresholds.

phase_audit: Review full fixed held intervals and frame-by-frame glyph/hand context. Retain original intentional-pause categories, annotate slowdown/sway/transport/lowering only where observed. Do not convert human pause duration into robot commands.
limits: No new model training, GE trajectories, robot action labels, depth or physical contact measurements
Native cadence may reduce per-step displacement but may also accumulate drift and loss
Higher coverage is not accuracy; agreement is only consistency
